machine: local Apple M5 Max arm64 macOS; Zig 0.15.2; ReleaseFast
execution_mode: Zig test binary, which disables the production global worker pool and uses one PoW worker. Both fold steps share this mode; this is not a packaged-program throughput measurement.
profile: sha-shift-v3 test harness; one private header, one joined native STARK proof, eight public Poseidon-root words
native_verification: Both fold steps accepted their own production-FRI-parameter test proofs; the test also rejects changed root, key, Gate claim, SHA word claim and mismatched private header.
interpretation: In this three-pair direct-binary run, fold step 4 reduced median non-PoW proving work by 13 ms (7.4%), proof size by 57,850 bytes (11.5%), and native verification by 8 ms. Its transcript found a much slower FRI PoW nonce, making actual wall proving much slower for this fixed input. PoW duration is transcript-dependent; these six runs repeat the same witness and therefore do not estimate throughput over distinct headers. The production package and non-test Key.validate still pin fold step 1. Fold step 4 is an experimental test configuration, not an admitted production profile.
reproduction: Build `zig build --build-file src/frontends/s31/build.zig test-sha-shift-circuit -Doptimize=ReleaseFast --verbose`, locate the emitted test binary, then run it directly with S31_SHA_SHIFT_PRODUCTION_BENCH=1 and with/without S31_SHA_SHIFT_FRI_FOLD4_BENCH=1. Alternate run order; subtract the two printed PoW stage times from prove_ms. Zig build's run-step cache can replay old output.
